+def test_shared_cache_refresh_replaces_memo():
+    import app.api as api
+    from app.store import _MEMO, DiskCache
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+        original_disk = api._disk
+        try:
+            api._disk = DiskCache(directory)
+            memo_put("sku", {"sku": "sku", "price": 1})
+            api._disk.put("sku", {"sku": "sku", "price": 2})
+            assert api.fetch_price("sku")["price"] == 2
+        finally:
+            api._disk = original_disk
+            _MEMO.pop("sku", None)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
